page.overview:
Who is Bob Anderson?

Bob Anderson was a British Formula One racing driver who competed from to . Anderson drove for DW Racing Enterprises in 29 Grands Prix over 5 seasons, scoring 8 World Championship points including one third place. He also competed in numerous major events as a motorcyclist, including the Isle of Man TT on three occasions.

Anderson died in 1967, at the age of 36, following an accident while testing at the Silverstone Circuit. In wet conditions, he slid off the track and collided with a marshals' post. Anderson suffered major head and neck injuries and later succumbed to his injuries at Northampton General Hospital.

While testing in Silverstone in wet conditions, Anderson's car slid off the track. The car struck a marshal's post. Anderson suffered serious chest and neck injuries and died later in the hospital,
